description: This file defines the 'Tool' class and related classes and functions used in build configuration, including methods for initialization, validation, and property management of build tools within a build system.

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Represents a build tool with properties such as command, output extensions, and substitution patterns, and methods for initialization, validation, and completion.

classes.name: CTool
classes.description: Base class for specific tool types, used for RTTI and type casting.

classes.name: GeneralTool
classes.description: Derived class representing a general build tool category.

classes.name: RustTool
classes.description: Derived class representing a Rust-specific build tool.

classes.name: BuiltinTool
classes.description: Derived class representing a built-in tool category.

methods.name: InitTool
methods.description: Initializes the tool from a scope, toolchain, and error object.

methods.name: SetComplete
methods.description: Marks the tool as fully configured and complete.

methods.name: ValidateSubstitution
methods.description: Validates substitutions used in the tool.

methods.name: AsC
methods.description: Returns the tool as a CTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: AsGeneral
methods.description: Returns the tool as a GeneralTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: AsRust
methods.description: Returns the tool as a RustTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: AsBuiltin
methods.description: Returns the tool as a BuiltinTool pointer if applicable.

methods.name: SetToolComplete
methods.description: Completes the setup of the tool, marking it as ready.
